# WeFounders

> The Global Startup Launchpad & Beta Testing Platform

WeFounders (https://wefounders.dev) is an open founder and builder community designed to connect early-stage software startups with verified beta testers and early adopters.

## Core Capabilities

- **Startup Showcases**: Public directory of live products, MVPs, and beta software across AI, SaaS, Mobile, Fintech, and Developer Tools.
- **Beta Testing Quests**: Structured challenges created by founders specifying target devices, user instructions, and testing criteria.
- **Karma & Reputation System**: Testers earn Karma by submitting bug reports and product feedback. Top builders appear on the global leaderboard.
- **Makers & Founders**: Verified profiles showcasing launches, updates, follower networks, and team collaboration opportunities.
- **Community Collab**: A matching platform where founders find co-founders, advisors, developers, designers, and marketers.

## Key Public URLs

- Homepage & Launchpad: https://wefounders.dev/
- Startups Directory: https://wefounders.dev/startups
- Product Radar & Feed: https://wefounders.dev/discover
- Active Testing Quests: https://wefounders.dev/quests
- Community Collaborations: https://wefounders.dev/collab
- Global Leaderboard: https://wefounders.dev/leaderboard
- How It Works: https://wefounders.dev/how-it-works
- Press & Media Kit: https://wefounders.dev/press

## Technology Architecture

- Frontend & Server: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components, React 19)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS with Archivo/Inter typography
- Database: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL
- Authentication: Clerk (required only for writing actions, not public browsing)
- Icons: Phosphor Icons exclusively
